why: Filmstrip from k=0 shows a clean transit of the left gate: the yellow post and cyan crossbar grow steadily, the crossbar passes overhead out of frame, and the yellow post ends up sliding to the right edge and vanishing by the last frame -- classic grow-and-pass-behind signature, not a slide-off-without-growing.
